rawText: is one of the main issues with Traders nowadays because they just pull up to a chart and because they see the overall movement heading up or the overall movement heading down they think a market is bullish or a market is bearish and that cannot be further from the truth this is one of the biggest mistakes that Traders make and say they are not analyzing the market structure correctly they are not analyzing the trend of the market correctly the simplest example that I can leave of this is let's say that you you are hunting and a hunter in order for it to catch its prey they follow footsteps or the tracks of an animal if you aren't reading correctly the tracks of an animal if it's going in one direction or if it was coming towards this direction you can completely be walking the opposite way of where the animal is going and this is exactly what people do when they analyze the markets incorrectly they can assume that they're reading it correctly but are actually doing the complete opposite and just digging themselves in a deeper hole and
sectionTitle: Visual slope is not trend: the hunter analogy
